entries.final_answer: Operator ruling 2026-11-22 (Ancestor blob + keep-code, relayed by the dispatcher, ledger R68): status.events.jsonl keeps its line-containment check; status.json, meta.json and tasks/WP*.md of the lane's own Mission are set aside only when the lane's blob is an ancestor version of the target's copy (the lane never authored it). Never trust a merge-tree or merge-driver result on kitty-specs/**. Everything else fails closed.
